name_en: light soy broth with very thin wavy noodles
summary_ja: 極細の縮れ麺と、あっさりした醤油スープ。港町の朝にも食べられる軽さが身上。
summary_en: Very thin wavy noodles in a light soy broth — gentle enough for a port town's morning.

name_en: curry broth ramen from the steel town
summary_ja: カレーをスープに仕立てた一杯。とろみのあるスープが麺に絡む。
summary_en: Ramen in a proper curry broth, thick enough to cling to the noodles.

name_en: niboshi broth of the Tsugaru region
summary_ja: 煮干しを軸にした醤油スープ。あっさりから濃厚まで、煮干しの効かせ方で幅がある。
summary_en: A soy broth built on dried sardines, ranging from delicate to intensely niboshi-forward.

name_en: light soy with dried fish and local chicken
summary_ja: 煮干しと地鶏ガラのあっさりした醤油スープに細縮れ麺。
summary_en: A light soy broth of dried fish and local chicken bones, with thin wavy noodles.

name_ja: 味噌カレー牛乳ラーメン
name_en: miso, curry and milk in one bowl
summary_ja: 味噌にカレーと牛乳を合わせた青森市の名物。バターを乗せる店が多い。
summary_en: Aomori City's famous mash-up of miso, curry and milk — often crowned with butter.

name_en: kansui-free noodles in a delicate broth
summary_ja: かんすいを使わない細縮れ麺と、あっさりした和風だしの醤油スープ。
summary_en: Thin wavy noodles made without kansui, in a delicate Japanese-stock soy broth.

name_en: harbor-town soy with house-made noodles
summary_ja: 自家製麺の文化が根強い港町の醤油ラーメン。魚介の出汁を効かせる。
summary_en: A harbor town's soy ramen with a strong house-made-noodle tradition and seafood stock.

name_en: chilled ramen served with ice
summary_ja: スープまで冷たい、氷の浮かぶラーメン。暑い盆地の夏が生んだ。
summary_en: Ramen served fully chilled, ice floating in the broth — born of the basin's hot summers.

name_en: miso ramen with a ball of chili miso
summary_ja: 味噌スープの中央に辛味噌を乗せ、溶かしながら味を変えて食べる。
summary_en: Miso ramen with a knob of chili miso in the center, dissolved gradually to shift the flavor.

name_en: soy ramen topped with simmered chicken giblets
summary_ja: 醤油ラーメンに鶏モツの煮込みを乗せる新庄の型。
summary_en: Shinjo's own: soy ramen topped with soft-simmered chicken giblets.

name_en: dark soy broth of Koriyama
summary_ja: 濃口醤油の黒いスープ。見た目より飲み口はまろやか。
summary_en: A near-black soy broth that drinks milder than it looks.

name_en: salt ramen made with mountain salt
summary_ja: 温泉水から作る山塩を使った塩ラーメン。まろやかな塩気が特徴。
summary_en: Salt ramen seasoned with mountain salt drawn from hot-spring water — rounder than sea salt.

name_en: sweet-spicy ankake over cold noodles
summary_ja: レバーと野菜の甘辛あんを、冷やした麺にかける「冷やし」が名物。
summary_en: Liver and vegetables in a sweet-spicy glaze, ladled over chilled noodles.

name_en: soy ramen topped with simmered chicken
summary_ja: 鶏ガラの醤油スープに、鶏肉のチャーシューを乗せる。
summary_en: Chicken-bone soy broth finished with chicken chashu instead of pork.

name_en: soy broth under a layer of chopped raw onion
summary_ja: 刻み玉ねぎを浮かべた醤油スープ。表面の油が玉ねぎの甘みを引き出す。
summary_en: Soy broth strewn with chopped raw onion, its sweetness drawn out by the surface oil.

name_en: broth made from chashu simmering liquid
summary_ja: チャーシューの煮汁を湯で割っただけのスープ。乾麺を使う店もある漁師町の型。
summary_en: The broth is simply chashu simmering liquid cut with hot water — a fishing town's invention, sometimes over dried noodles.

name_en: rayu-red soy soup with minced pork and onion
summary_ja: 醤油スープにラー油を効かせ、玉ねぎと挽肉を乗せる。海女の冷えた体を温めた一杯。
summary_en: A soy soup flooded with chili oil, onion and minced pork — built to warm divers coming out of the sea.

name_en: soy noodles under a hot moyashi ankake
summary_ja: もやし中心の野菜あんを熱々のままかける。横浜の中華食堂で生まれた。
summary_en: Noodles blanketed in a scalding bean-sprout ankake, born in Yokohama's Chinese diners.

name_en: egg-drop chili soup, Kawasaki style
summary_ja: 溶き卵と唐辛子、にんにくのスープ。担々麺とは別物の川崎の味。
summary_en: Egg-drop soup fired with chili and garlic — Kawasaki's own thing, not a tantanmen at all.

name_en: jet-black soy broth built for rice
summary_ja: 真っ黒な濃口醤油スープに粗挽き胡椒。白飯と食べる前提の濃さで生まれた。
summary_en: A jet-black soy broth under cracked pepper — salted to be eaten with rice on the side.

name_en: niboshi soy under a snowfall of back fat
summary_ja: 煮干し醤油に背脂を浮かべ、極太麺を合わせる。金属加工の町の労働食として育った。
summary_en: Niboshi soy broth under a layer of pork back fat, with extra-thick noodles — fuel for the metalworking town.

name_ja: 長岡生姜醤油ラーメン
name_en: soy broth warmed through with ginger
summary_ja: 生姜を強く効かせた醤油スープ。雪国の体を芯から温める。
summary_en: Soy broth carrying a strong charge of ginger — warmth for snow country.

name_en: the curry ramen town of Sanjo
summary_ja: カレースープのラーメンが市内に根付く。家庭でも食堂でも食べられてきた。
summary_en: Curry-broth ramen rooted across the town, at home and in diners alike.

name_en: morning ramen, hot bowl then cold bowl
summary_ja: 朝からラーメンを食べる習慣。温かい一杯と冷たい一杯をセットで頼む型がある。
summary_en: A town that eats ramen at breakfast — often a hot bowl followed by a cold one.

name_en: Nagoya's chili-laced minced pork ramen
summary_ja: 唐辛子とにんにくを効かせた醤油スープに台湾ミンチ。名古屋で生まれ、台湾には無い。
summary_en: Soy broth fired with chili and garlic under seasoned minced pork. Born in Nagoya — not found in Taiwan.

name_en: extra-thick noodles in dark chicken soy
summary_ja: うどんのような極太ストレート麺と、鶏ガラの濃い醤油スープ。
summary_en: Udon-thick straight noodles in a dark, chicken-based soy broth.

name_en: white cabbage, garlic and a spicy edge
summary_ja: 白菜をたっぷり炒め、にんにくとピリ辛を効かせた醤油スープ。
summary_en: A soy broth loaded with stir-fried hakusai cabbage, garlic and a spicy edge.

name_en: noticeably sweet soy broth of Nishiwaki
summary_ja: はっきり甘い醤油スープ。織物工場で働く女性たちに好まれて定着したと伝わる。
summary_en: A distinctly sweet soy broth, said to have taken root among the town's textile-mill workers.

name_en: broth simmered from beef bones
summary_ja: 牛骨でとったスープの香ばしさと軽い甘み。県中部で長く日常の味になっている。
summary_en: A broth simmered from beef bones — toasty, faintly sweet, and everyday fare in central Tottori.

name_en: old-hen chicken soy with kashiwa chashu
summary_ja: 親鶏でとった醤油スープに、鶏チャーシュー。養鶏の町の歴史が残した型。
summary_en: Soy broth from old laying hens, topped with chicken chashu — a legacy of the poultry town.

name_en: ramen served boiling in an earthen pot
summary_ja: 土鍋で煮立てたまま出す親鶏の醤油ラーメン。生卵とちくわを落とす。
summary_en: Old-hen soy ramen served still boiling in an earthen pot, with a raw egg and chikuwa dropped in.

name_en: soft tonkotsu finished with a raw egg
summary_ja: やわらかい炊き加減の豚骨スープ。生卵を落とす食べ方が根付く。
summary_en: A gentler take on tonkotsu, customarily finished with a raw egg.

name_en: mild tonkotsu with pickled daikon on the side
summary_ja: あっさりとした豚骨スープ。卓上の漬物と一緒に食べる店が多い。
summary_en: A mild, drinkable tonkotsu, often eaten with the pickled daikon kept on the table.
